# KlickBox

> Multi-tenant iPhone task manager. Each User deploys their own OpenClaw
> agent against a shared REST API to manage Tasks, Tags, and the Archive.
> This index is for agents. Start with the integration guide.

Base URL: `https://oyarcsgekpltnxjmidqk.functions.supabase.co/api-key-auth`
Auth: send `Authorization: Bearer $KLICKBOX_API_KEY` on every request. The
host is the same for every User; per-User isolation comes from the key.

## Fast path for agents

If you just need to start making calls, the tool contract plus the create
example below are enough on their own — fetch
https://soltaniehha.com/klickbox-docs/tools.json and go. The three docs
overlap heavily, so don't read all three: reach for the domain glossary
(context.md) only to settle a vocabulary dispute — what exactly a "Primary
Tag", "Effective Score", or "Base Score" means — and the integration guide
for the longer worked examples (attachments, Task Families, error codes).

## Create a Task (works after this single fetch)

```bash
curl -sS \
  "https://oyarcsgekpltnxjmidqk.functions.supabase.co/api-key-auth/rpc/create_task_with_tags" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KLICKBOX_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"p_title":"Review the Q2 deck","p_base_score":80,"p_due_date":"2026-05-10T17:00:00Z"}'
# -> { "id": "<task-uuid>", ... }
```

`p_base_score` is 0–100 and **relative to the User's other Tasks**, so GET
the existing tasks first to calibrate (`/tasks?status=eq.active`) rather than
inventing your own scale. See "Choosing a Base Score" in the integration guide.

## Docs

- [OpenClaw integration guide](https://soltaniehha.com/klickbox-docs/openclaw-integration.md): wire an agent to a User's KlickBox.
- [Domain glossary](https://soltaniehha.com/klickbox-docs/context.md): canonical vocabulary — Task, Tag, Base Score, Primary Tag, etc.
- [Tool contract (JSON)](https://soltaniehha.com/klickbox-docs/tools.json): machine-readable tool surface.
